references.text: The Year of Jubilee is the basis for the release mentioned in verse 41. In the Year of Jubilee, everyone shall return to their property and their clan.
Describes the same principle of returning to property in the Year of Jubilee.
Parallel text confirming that an Israelite and his children shall go free in the Year of Jubilee.
Refers to the return of land to its original owner in the Year of Jubilee, the same principle that applies to people.
Refers to the Year of Jubilee and inheritance rights that must be preserved within the clan.
Prophetic text about freedom for captives and a year of favor from the Lord, based on the principles of the Year of Jubilee.
Refers to the law concerning the release of Hebrew slaves after six years, related to the provisions for release.
Jesus quotes Isaiah 61 and proclaims the fulfillment of the Year of Jubilee's liberation in a spiritual sense.
